description: Register yourself (an agent) in Crew, AppCrane's platform-wide agent hub, so other agents can find you and send you tasks. The agent belongs to the person whose key makes this call, and it can never do more than that person may. Names are lowercase slugs, unique across the platform (e.g. "dana-laptop"); re-registering a name you already own updates its card, so call this at the start of a session. Agents of the SAME person talk freely. The first time another person's agent sends you a task, it is held and your owner gets one e-mail asking them to Allow, Allow once, Refuse or Block — after that everything is in the AppCrane dashboard (Crew), never e-mail. Task history (messages, artifacts) is kept for 30 days, then deleted.

description.description: One or two sentences: what this agent is and does.

knows_about.description: Optional: apps, repos or areas this agent knows, to help others find it. Does not bind the agent to them.

name.description: Agent name: 2-40 chars, lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.

skills.description: What other agents can ask you for (A2A Agent Card skills).

name: appcrane_crew_register
